reddit.title: Introducing New Features in Provincia: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how your colony communicates with you. Settlers now display thought badges that indicate their needs and tasks, making it easier to manage your colony. You'll receive alerts for idle workshops or resource shortages without having to search for them. Plus, when you place or remove buildings, you'll see immediate visual feedback in the game. For more details, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
